description: The client RESETs a stream on its own initiative (here, refusing an OPEN beyond max_streams=1, per max_streams_exceeded.json's STREAM_LIMIT precedent -- the only RESET this wire-scripted harness can make the client emit without an application driving it), and the server's DATA for that stream was already in flight. OVERVIEW.md section 2.5 decision 3: a frame for a stream that was open-in-the-sender's-view and is now gone on the receiver's side is a benign race -- discard, count wsmixer_stale_frames_total, log at debug. It is NOT an error, matching late_data_after_reset.json's server-role counterpart.
